verdict.rationale: Factory documents a real API (openapi.json) and an API reference for creating/managing Droid sessions, plus an SDK exposing the same agent harness as CLI/desktop/web, showing genuine API-level parity for core session workflows. However, there's no evidence the API surfaces UI-exclusive features like Missions orchestration, readiness-report/readiness-fix, Software Factory dashboards, or integration management, so full UI-API parity isn't demonstrated. Missing for 10: API endpoints for Missions, readiness commands, Software Factory metrics/dashboard, and integration configuration; independent confirmation of parity.
